Introduction

Chloe is a South Korean singer formerly under C9 Entertainment. She was a member of the girl group cignature. She joined the group on June 14th, 2021, following the departure of Haeun and Sunn. She later made her debut with the group on November 30 with their second EP "Dear Diary Moment".

Chloe is currently pursuing a degree in data science, she is a student at the esteemed University of Michigan, which is among the top colleges in the United States.
